title: FlowTestView - Data API
description: Represents the description of a flow test associated with a flow definition. This object is available in API version 55.0 and later.

Description.description: The description of the flow test associated with the flow test view.

DurableId.description: The ID of the flow test associated with this flow test view.

FlowDefinitionViewId.description: The ID of the flow definition associated with the flow test view. This is a relationship field.

FlowTestApiName.description: The API name of the flow test associated with the flow test view.

FlowTestLabel.description: The label of the flow test associated with the flow test view.
